additional_info.body:
Dear Luigi Iodice,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R9 170002723
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
fq2t11 , 63Vm6i
Problem Description
:
0kWh sessions
Troubleshooting
: We have analysed the logs and below are our findings:
Charger: MP / R9 170002723
23rd March
session : This session was aborted due to cable was unplugged as you can see in the below snapshot and after that when the cable was connected again, the session was successful.
22nd March
: In the below session the cable was not yet connected, that's why the charging session was not started resulting in zero session.
20th March 17:55:39
: This charging session got aborted due to authentication is not being done & the issue arises from the EV side as you can see the ERR_EVCOM EV Communication detected. There is no issue from the charger side.
20th March 17:47
: This charging session was also got aborted due to Authentication and Cable connection is not done in timely manner, as the connection got timed out.
18th March
: The charging session got aborted due to cable not yet connected and rest we don't see any issues in rest of the charging session.
Charger : MP / RD 170003001
25th March
:The session got aborted due to cable not connected in the first RemoteStart Transaction and while the connector goes to Preparing, there were multiple remote start transaction was send in between resulting it to zero sessions.
23rd March
: All the charging session I have checked and in all the RemoteStartTransaction ,we have cable not yet connected resulting it to zero sessions.
We conclude that there are no issues on the charger side. All sessions were aborted either due to the cable not being connected, authentication not being done in a timely manner, or communication issues from the EV side.
Please let us know if you have any further query to discuss, if not we shall proceed with closing this ticket.
For future reference, your case number is
0414939
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,

Shrey Sharma

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414939-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002723] Iplanet - 0kWh sessions CRM:00643001359
additional_info.body:
Hi Luigi,
We have checked it and that was because of the Error Polling Coap
which means the internal communication with SECC was lost for a brief period of time. Our charger will reconnect to SECC within 5 seconds. While SECC is not reachable, an 'Outlet Out of Order' flag will be active and will be cleared once the charger reconnects to SECC. We have observed that this issue does not occur frequently.
I hope everything has been clarified. If there are no further questions, may we proceed with closing this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
